How have you been?

Please forgive me for replying so late. There's been lots of trouble in the Underworld, and the orphanage is overcrowded with the injured, so I haven't had time to do anything apart from treating the wounded. I even had to send some of the younger children to foster families in town, because I didn't want them to see the carnage inside the orphanage.

As for your previous question — yes, I've heard rumors about the Supreme Guardian about to order a blockade between the Over- and Underworlds. I understand your concerns, but from my point of view, there is no way I can abandon the people down here right now. During this extraordinary state of panic, I can only hope to use my modest skills to bring a modicum of comfort to the needy.

Fortunately, I know you'll respect my decision. I still remember when I was fresh out of college and Dad told me, "Anyone going into medicine to just get a decent job will come to regret their decision sooner or later." I think I understand more than ever what you meant back then.

I don't know when we'll ever be able to see each other again, but I hope you can be healthy and happy. Your daughter is a big girl now, and can take care of herself, so you don't have to worry about me.

The harmonious music guides you to stumble into the sweet dream, as syrup and soda fill your throat.
The festival is grand, the crowd boisterous, and strangers cast on disguises to meet up in the dream.
You view to your hearts' desires the wondrous and otherworldly views, and part ways when dewdrops shimmer with the break of dawn —
When the pitch-black midnight has just begun.

The clock hands go tick-tock, and death follows closely like a shadow.
You are placed onto the table as a bargaining chip, but manage to win for yourself the right to uncover the secret.
You bring with you the dreams of the dead and continue on the road that they did not walk, facing the enemies they could not defeat—

The false god rises in the conglomeration of the multitude's wishes, and the unanimous song of the gazillions drowns out your existence.
Those walking on different roads take up each other's hands,
your melodies interweave with each other, faint but imperishable like the lights in a long night.
One after one, people startle awake from their dream. That tiny song finally merges into a deafening roar in the end, tearing free of the dream's curtains.

The eternal sweet dream scatters in a fleeting instant, and you finally understand why people slumber
— They do so towards a dawn freed from dreams.

<align="center"><size=36>The Alchemy Commission's Official Gazette</size></align>

<align="right">Current Date: August 2, Year <unbreak>8100</unbreak> Star Calendar</align>

Appointment of Lingsha as the Head of the Alchemy Commission aboard the Xianzhou Luofu.

<align="right">Xianzhou Alliance Marshal's Office</align>

<align="center"><size=36>Alchemy Commission - Official Gazette: Comments Section</size></align>

<align="right">Current Date: August 2, Year <unbreak>8100</unbreak> Star Calendar</align>
<align="right">It is advisable to clean up and avoid taking time off</align>
<align="right">Have less chatter about trivial matters, and discuss more about serious topics — Officer of the Comments Section</align>

<align="center"><size=32>Breaking News: New Cauldron Master to Assume Duties Soon!</size></align>

The less said, the more significant the event. So, who exactly is Lingsha?

<align="right">Signed, Lingering Clouds</align>

You don't know Lingsha? Are you even part of the alchemy scene? She's the apprentice of our former Cauldron Master, Lady Yunhua. Heard they both headed off to the Zhuming, so this is like a homecoming for her.

<align="right">Signed, Unconcerned in the Medical Hut</align>

Whoever she is, our Alchemy Commission finally has someone putting things in order!
Since Yunhua left, the Cauldron Master position's been vacant for ages. Then there was that incident... The Alchemy Commission's been in a rough spot, badly needing a capable leader.
Let's hope Lady Lingsha can lead us to restore the Alchemy Commission's former glory. Everyone, let's give her our full support!

<align="right">Signed, Yuluo</align>

Talk about a sudden leadership shake-up in the morning. We figured they'd promote you, Yuluo, to be the new Cauldron Master.

<align="right">Signed, Thunderous Scalegorge Tides</align>

Oh, knock it off. I can't be the Cauldron Master. Just being the chief alchemist already keeps me busy as a one-armed paper hanger.

<align="right">Signed, Yuluo</align>

I reckon Lady Lingsha is in for a rough ride. The Alchemy Commission is like a hot potato right now — everyone's avoiding it.
After that incident, a lot of colleagues got dragged into it. Now, we're seriously short-staffed in all departments. Be it healers, alchemists, or assistants.
The bigwigs from the other commissions aren't giving us warm welcomes either. They reckon the Alchemy Commission's gonna cause trouble again sooner or later, and some even suggested splitting our commission up.
Who knows how the new Cauldron Master's gonna clean up this mess?

<align="right">Signed, Peeved Bald Healer</align>

Seriously, what's all the fuss about? I've got complete confidence in Lady Lingsha. 
First off, she's a top-tier healer from the Xianzhou Zhuming, so her medical skills are undoubtedly top-notch.
Plus, she's had experience working and studying on multiple Xianzhou ships. She was hired by the IPC as a medical expert and even served in the military. She's got the skills and the know-how, no doubt about it.
To top it all off, she's one of our own from the Luofu. We couldn't ask for a better fit for Cauldron Master.

<align="right">Signed, Unconcerned in the Medical Hut</align>

Are you guys even paying attention to the important details in the bulletin? The big deal isn't who the new Cauldron Master is but who appointed them.
Usually, high-ranking officials of the Luofu are chosen through discussions among the Six Commissions, but this time, the Cauldron Master was directly appointed by the high-ups of the Xianzhou Alliance.
Think about what that means. Really think it through carefully.

<align="right">Signed, Silent Watchers See All</align>

I'm too dense to figure this out on my own. Just tell me what's going on.

<align="right">Signed, Lingering Clouds</align>

You really have no sense for politics, do you?
With something as major as the Arbor's resurrection, the Alliance high-ups are definitely looking to hold someone accountable. And they need a big name to take the fall.
Check out the Wardance — the Yaoqing and Zhuming generals have both shown up. They say they are present to observe the ceremonies, but I think they're really here to question General Jing Yuan.
So, the arrival of Lady Lingsha is pretty interesting. Could it be a way to keep an eye on or counterbalance General Jing Yuan?
After all, I heard that Lady Yunhua was exiled from the Luofu. Now, her apprentice returns to settle the score. It seems like a natural course of events, doesn't it?

<align="right">Signed, Silent Watchers See All</align>

That... that makes sense. So, are we gearing up for some political showdown?

<align="right">Signed, Lingering Clouds</align>

Enough with the wild guesses. Lady Lingsha is about to arrive at the Alchemy Commission. Let's hurry up and get ready to make a good impression on the new Cauldron Master!

<align="right">Signed, Yuluo</align>

◆ Introduction ◆
● During the event, Trailblazers can participate in the following events and obtain their rewards.

◆ Journey Highlights ◆
● Journey Highlights display the latest featured events in the current version, as well as displaying key event rewards such as Stellar Jade and Star Rail Special Passes, and their acquisition status.
● After the event ends, the corresponding rewards will not be calculated in the Rewards Overview.

◆ 3-Day Check-In ◆
● Log into the game every day to receive rewards. The rewards are renewed every day at <unbreak>04</unbreak>:<unbreak>00</unbreak> server time. Daily log-in rewards can only be received once per day. A maximum of 3 days of rewards are provided.

◆ Returners' Benefits ◆
● You can claim the Returners' Presents rewards, which include Character Building materials and a certain number of Fuel Vouchers based on your offline days. Fuel Vouchers can be used to quickly obtain materials from the Calyx/Stagnant Shadow.
● During the event, Trailblazers will gain <unbreak>50%</unbreak> more The Nameless EXP from completing Nameless Honor missions. This bonus will expire at <unbreak>04</unbreak>:<unbreak>00</unbreak> (server time) on the Monday after the event ends.
During the return period, Trailblazers will receive double drops for completing Calyx, Cavern of Corrosion, and Planar Ornament challenges. After the double drops challenges are expended, gain an additional reward atop the original rewards already earned.
※ Should other double-reward events like Garden of Plenty occur at the same time as Starlit Homecoming, the daily double drop for Garden of Plenty and other events will be consumed first when obtaining rewards.

◆ Gold Gear Selector ◆
● Claim the Gold Gear Selector reward and pick any character to immediately receive a matching set of +<unbreak>15</unbreak> Gold Relics.
● Trailblazers can only claim the Gold Gear Selector reward once per event period.

◆ Returning Guide ◆
Complete the survey to earn rewards. The rewards will be sent via mail. The survey can only be filled in once. If you have already submitted the survey, you cannot fill in or modify it again.
